newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi stocks higher at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Delhi stocks higher at mid-session.

text.p: Persistent buying by foreign institutions and domestic investors on news that Reliance Industries will consider a bonus issue pushed stocks in Delhi higher in afternoon trade on Friday, brokers said.
At 12:45 p.m. (O715 GMT) the Delhi Stock Exchange Benchmark Index was up 13.44 points at 874.55.
"The market has turned distinctly firm as bull operators have been tightening their grip, even on the last day of the current settlement," said B.B. Nagpal of stock brokers B.B. Portfolio.
Reliance climbed 15.50 rupees, or nearly five percent, to 357.
State Bank of India gained seven rupees to 330.60.
Associated Cement Companies Ltd climbed 34.50 rupees to 1,236.
Hindustan Lever Ltd gained three rupees to 1,368.
ITC Ltd rose two rupees to 506.
